messages.author: c668ff280114b165
messages.subject: manual selection as MSImage
parts:
Hello again Kyle,
Now I am trying to create a new MSImageSet from pre-existing one using the select method.
I write 
> my_selection <- select(my_msset, mode="region")
Then Cardinal show me an image of my msset to select the region of interest. So I select that region and press esc to finish. Cardinal create a new objetct called my_selection but it is not a MSImageSet class, but a logical one. So I can't do anything with this selection. Cardinal return me errror messages like
> image(tmp, mz=944)
Error in image.default(tmp, mz = 944) : argument must be matrix-like

How can I create an appropiate MSImageSet class using the select method?
Thanks in advance

messages.author: 5276ff4387de2618
messages.subject: Re: manual selection as MSImage
parts:
Hi,

You would then do:

my_msset2 <- my_msset[,my_selection]

to make a subsetted MSImageSet using the selected pixels.

The select() method returns a logical vector of the selected pixels instead of an MSImageSet because there are more ways one might want to use the selection besides creating a new MSImageSet, such as using it as the response in fitting a statistical model.

Kyle
